provenance: Independent starter extension expectations, separate from model fixtures.

approved_reuse.steps: Approve EXT-SUPPORTED explicitly; exact repeat returns its approved wording while EXT-REUSE remains pending. An unapproved edit is excluded.

changed_source.steps: Approve EXT-CHANGE explicitly, update EXPORT-EXT to version 2, confirm review_required and blocked reuse with version 1 text retained; edit, validate and approve again before reuse.
